criterion: Rows: fauna, flora, fish, alphabetical; related rows banded together. Columns: what the game shows now first, then shadowed copies, renders newest first, history oldest first, donor last. The order ranks RECENCY and RUNTIME, never quality or worth.

RM_Hollu.note: No. The existing (B) render should be made into its own new creature: The Dancing Skresh, new description. But this Hollu is supposed to be a section of almost stained glass-like waveglass, the beautifully colored transparent organism that covers much of the topside ocean. It is a curved-in piece of this sheet in its final life stage.
